use_case_name: Generate Treatment Quality and Trend Reports

claims.content: To generate Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical reports from the Database and send them to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.

goal.raw_text: To generate Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical reports from the Database and send them to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
Payment terms agreed by the VSP are recorded in the VSP master, with Payment Type selected from Bi-Monthly or Monthly.
The VSP has submitted the Claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field office according to the payment terms.
The field office has validated the claim form manually and through the system; claims with missing or false mandatory information are rejected back to the VSP and kept in a quarantine area.

Based on the payment terms agreed by VSP, the MSIU Field Office User generates the Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report and sends it to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.

trigger.raw_text: Based on the payment terms agreed by VSP, the MSIU Field Office User generates the Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report and sends it to the MSIU Admin team to arrange payments for the VSP.

claims.content: Claim Processing reads from the Database and outputs to Reports.
Reports are generated from the Database and feed back to the Admin Team.
Based on the payment terms agreed by VSP, the field office generates Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report.
The field office sends the report to the MSIU Admin team to arrange the payments for the VSP.

If any of mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing, the field office rejects the claim back to VSP and the system keeps those claims in a quarantine area; the quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification, and if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims are entered on to the system in the following month’s batch.

If any of mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing then the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claim in a quarantine area; System only accept claims only if the mandatory information is complete.
The quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification.
If the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims will be entered on to the system, in the following month’s batch.
Exception exit: the claim is entered on to the system in the following month’s batch when the VSP returns it with satisfactory details.
Based on the payment terms agreed by the VSP, the field office has generated the Bi-Month or Monthly financial and medical report.
The report has been generated from the Database.
The report has been sent to the MSIU Admin team to arrange the payments for the VSP.
